3 days Golden Triangle private tour

Delhi · Agra · Jaipur · 3 days

3 days Golden Triangle tour packages Private tour Licensed guide

The classic route at its briskest: Delhi's monuments, a sunrise Taj Mahal and Jaipur's forts in three well-planned days.

At a glance

Duration
3 days, 2 nights
Destinations
Delhi · Agra · Jaipur
Transport
Private AC car
Accommodation

Tour type
Private
Pickup

Day 3, around 8 pm

What makes this one worth it

  • Old and New Delhi in one guided day
  • The Taj Mahal at sunrise
  • Agra Fort and Fatehpur Sikri on the road to Jaipur
  • Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal, City Palace and Jantar Mantar
  • Two nights in handpicked hotels, pickup and drop in Delhi

Your day by day

  1. Day 1

    Delhi sightseeing, then on to Agra

    Pickup at 9 am from your hotel or the airport. Old Delhi first — Jama Masjid, a cycle-rickshaw through Chandni Chowk, a walk through the Khari Baoli spice market and a photo stop outside the Red Fort. Then New Delhi — Humayun's Tomb, India Gate, a drive past Parliament House and Rashtrapati Bhavan, Qutub Minar and the Lotus Temple. In the evening, about three hours on the expressway to Agra. Overnight in Agra.

  2. Day 2

    Taj Mahal at sunrise, Agra Fort and the road to Jaipur

    The Taj Mahal at first light, then back to the hotel for breakfast and checkout. Agra Fort — its palaces, audience halls and views of the Taj — then west towards Jaipur with a stop at Fatehpur Sikri and the Buland Darwaza. About four hours in all. Overnight in Jaipur.

  3. Day 3

    Jaipur, then back to Delhi

    Breakfast and checkout. Amber Fort on its hill above the Aravallis, a photo stop at Jal Mahal on Man Sagar Lake, the Hawa Mahal and its 953 windows, the City Palace and the Jantar Mantar observatory. Then about four hours back to Delhi, with drop-off around 8 pm.

Questions people ask

Is this a private 3 Days Golden Triangle Tour?
Yes, completely private, with your own AC car, driver and licensed English-speaking local guides in each city.
Are monument entrance fees included?
Yes. All monument tickets are included in the price, and your guide handles them at each gate so you skip the ticket queue.
Is hotel accommodation included?
Yes, two nights are included, with a choice of three-star, four-star or five-star hotels. You can also book the tour without hotels and arrange your own stay.
What is the cancellation policy?
Cancel more than seven days before travel for a full refund of the deposit; closer to the date, costs already committed with hotels and transport are deducted. Our terms page has the details.
Can I customise this itinerary?
Yes. Timings, hotels and stops can all be tailored to the way you like to travel; just tell us when you enquire.
What is the best time to do this tour?
The tour runs all year, but October to March offers the most pleasant sightseeing weather. Keep in mind the Taj Mahal is closed on Fridays, so we plan your Agra day around that.
How far is Delhi from Agra and Jaipur?
Delhi to Agra is about 230 km, roughly three hours on the expressway, and Agra to Jaipur is about 240 km, around four to five hours by road.
What should I pack?
Comfortable clothes, good walking shoes, sunscreen, sunglasses and your passport and travel documents. Modest outfits that cover shoulders and knees are handy for temples and mosques.
What cultural experiences can I expect?
Grand Mughal and Rajput architecture, lively local bazaars, regional food and centuries-old heritage sites across all three cities.
Do I need to book tickets in advance?
It is wise to book early, especially in the October to March peak season. Once your tour is confirmed we reserve the hotels, car and guides, so the logistics are handled for you.
What are the main attractions?
The Taj Mahal and Agra Fort in Agra, Amber Fort and the City Palace in Jaipur, and India Gate, Qutub Minar and the Red Fort in Delhi.
